 Students urged to fill out FAFSA applications
 October 19, 2026 Local Stories 
 The 2027-2028 FAFSA application is now open.
 Tiffany Haddon, Success Program Manager at Detroit Regional Dollars for Scholars, says more than 40% of Michigan high school seniors and families waited until fall to complete their FAFSA, and that’s far too late.
 “The sooner the better is the general consensus, because the sooner that students and families can get the FAFSA completed, the sooner the colleges and universities receive their information, the sooner they’re in the running for those institutional dollars,” Haddon said. “And colleges do not have an unlimited amount of scholarship money, and as the pot empties.”
 Haddon says anyone thinking about attending college should fill out the FAFSA regardless of income level.
